text:
finance: Heads-up: we're updating billing policies next month. Key points: promo credits will expire after 90 days (grandfathering for old grants), and invoices will include route-level line items.

sara-cs: Will customers get email notices?

finance: Yes \u2014 30/14/3 day reminder cadence. We'll also show console banners for admins.

max-eng: Any API changes?

finance: New invoice export endpoints (CSV/JSON) and an optional header `x-rw-route-id` for explicit per-route attribution. Backwards-compatible inference remains.

julia-product: Can we add a short FAQ and example invoice in the docs?

finance: Yep, drafting the FAQ and a sample invoice diff. We'll post links once live.

billing-bot: TIMELINE: Day 0 announcement, Day 7 docs, Day 21 console preview, Day 90 credit expiry enforcement for new grants.

finance: Thanks all \u2014 reach out if you want to review customer messaging. End.
